summary: A 1933 pole lookout in the Flathead National Forest north of Whitefish, reported destroyed in 1957 by one source and removed by another; no site description found.

facts.status_note: firelookout.com gives Destroyed 1957; Forest Lookouts marks it Removed; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list reads Tower Gone.

events.note: firelookout.com: 20-ft pole L-4 tower. Only source for the build year.
firelookout.com: Destroyed 1957. Forest Lookouts gives no date and says Removed, so the cause and manner of loss are unconfirmed.

evidence.supports: Flathead National Forest; about 12 miles north of Whitefish; Flathead County
Forest Lookouts files the entry under the Flathead National Forest
Forest Lookouts marks the entry Removed
Forest Fire Lookout Association list: Tower Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. firelookout.com says destroyed in 1957; Forest Lookouts says Removed with no date; the FFLA list says Tower Gone. The story reports the wording of each source and does not pick one. Destroyed and removed are different outcomes.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only firelookout.com gives a build year (1933), tower size and end date (1957). Forest Lookouts and the FFLA list give status only, and they describe the ending differently from firelookout.com. One web search and a grep of the Flathead National Forest history (Trails of the Past, npshistory chapters) found nothing specific to this lookout; those hits concern the Big Creek Ranger Station on the North Fork. Elevation 6,430 ft from firelookout.com; the record has no elevation field. Do not confuse with Big Creek Baldy (us-mt-big-creek-baldy), a standing Kootenai NF tower in Lincoln County. No staffing, fire or site-today information found; the story omits those topics.
